chunks: When he approached it, a voice called out: O Moses

key_terms.نُودِيَ: He was called out to (passive verb indicating divine call)

ai.seo_question: What happened when Moses approached the fire in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In this pivotal moment from Surah Taa-Haa, the divine call 'O Moses' marks the transition from Moses' humble arrival at the burning bush to his formal commissioning as a prophet. Shia scholarship emphasizes this direct address as a sign of God's intimate knowledge and selection, establishing the foundation for the revelation of the Torah and the subsequent leadership of the Bani Israel.
